The position plays a key role in ensuring system availability, network connectivity, data integrity, and cybersecurity readiness. Responsibilities include proactively identifying and resolving technical issues, automating administrative processes, supporting infrastructure improvements, and ensuring consistent IT operations across all locations. PowerShell scripting for administration and reporting. Hands-on experience with at least one business firewall/SD-WAN platform (e.g., Fortinet, Meraki, Palo Alto, SonicWall, Ubiquiti), plus routing and VPN fundamentals. Experience with a hypervisor (Hyper-V, VMware or Proxmox) and core Windows Server roles. Experience running a backup product (e.g., Veeam, Datto, Acronis) and performing restores. OSPF or BGP over VPN, 802.1X/NPS, Wi-Fi site surveys and Wireshark or similar. Experience migrating off VMware. Basic Linux administration.
